Subject: Whistic access + profile stewardship / SSO mapping / SOC2 evidence freeze

Hi Kimberly,

Quick intro — I'm Emily Ross on the FinBank security team. We're prepping for an internal audit and want to (1) claim/admin the Whistic profile for FinBank so Redwood can respond to a scoped SIG/C-AIQ set, (2) map our Okta SAML IdP to Redwood's Whistic stewardship account, and (3) request a short evidence "freeze" window while we complete a SOC 2 readout so we can provide consistent artifacts.

Can you confirm the info your team needs from us to claim the profile and set the SSO mapping? High-level asks from our side:
- Which email alias will Redwood use as the delegated steward on Whistic?
- What Okta metadata or certificate do you need (SP/ACS)?
- Suggested timeline for SSO test and claim handoff — we're aiming for next week if possible.
- We would like Redwood to avoid removing or reclassifying any existing evidence in Whistic for the audit window through 2027-10-10. Is that something you can accommodate?

I've attached a short SOC 2 summary and our internal contact list. Procurement is cc'd for any licensing or contract confirmations.

Attachments: SOC2_Summary_Q3.pdf (summary, 2 pages)

Thanks — appreciate a short mutual action plan and a target time for the SSO test.

Emily Ross
Senior Manager, Security
FinBank
security@finbank.com

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the SOC 2 summary. Welcome — glad to help streamline this. Proposed mutual action plan below (short and actionable):

1) Delegated steward & claims
   - Please confirm the email you want Redwood to use as the delegated steward. Our recommendation is 'security-portal@redwood.com' (we use a team alias so ownership is stable).
2) SSO mapping (Okta)
   - Supply your Okta metadata XML or an IdP metadata URL (we can accept either). We will configure a new SP entry on our Whistic admin console and send back an SP metadata file for your Okta admin to import.
   - Proposed SSO test window: Tue 2027-09-28 or Wed 2027-09-29 (30–45 min slot). Which works for you?
3) Evidence freeze
   - We can respect a read-only freeze for FinBank-owned evidence through 2027-10-10. We'll mark evidence uploaded by FinBank as "Do not modify — audit freeze" and avoid automated pruning.
4) Evidence upload & artifacts
   - We'll upload a short Redwood SOC2 digest and a named manifest referencing the items we intend to claim. Please attach any additional artifacts to the Whistic profile after we complete the claim.

Attachments: whistic-invite.link (we'll send an invite to the steward alias once you confirm), internal-checklist.txt (checklist of fields we will claim)

Next steps for you: confirm steward alias and either paste the Okta metadata XML or provide an SSO metadata endpoint. If Tue/Wed next week works, tell us preferred time (PST). We'll take care of claims and set the profile permissions accordingly.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Security Partnerships Lead
Redwood Inference

- Okta metadata: attaching FinBank_OKTA_metadata.xml (IdP metadata, includes cert and entityID). Our Okta admin (procurement@finbank.com) can import SP metadata when you provide it.
- SSO test window: Tue 2027-09-28 at 10:00 AM PST works for our Okta admin.
- Evidence freeze: confirmed — FinBank requests that Redwood mark any FinBank-origin evidence as read-only through 2027-10-10. Procurement is aware of potential contract notes.

Also — procurement indicated there may be a short questions list about liability limits for evidence hosting. They will follow up separately; no blocking items for the initial claim and SSO mapping.
